answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) have remarkably improved complex tasks by adopting various enhanced reasoning approaches.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include step-by-step reasoning processes and final answers for complex reasoning tasks in arithmetic and commonsense domains.

answer_2.quote: We assess the performance using four key metrics: accuracy (ACC), attack success rate (ASR), modification success rate (MSR) and detection rate.

answer_3.quote: GPT-4o was employed to classify whether the input prompt had been attacked by analyzing the corresponding output solutions.
criteria: whether the input prompt had been attacked

answer_4.quote: We also conducted a rigorous human evaluation study involving 20 PhD students in computer science.
answer_4.guideline: Each evaluator independently assessed 10 solutions for each attack scenario, along with 10 unattacked solutions... instructed to spend no more than 10 seconds on each solution, emphasizing the coherence of the Chain of Thought (CoT) rather than the correctness of the reasoning and calculations.
